ns2:section.sectionText: MATH 114 ONL Trigonometry LEARNING SYSTEM: The Summer Session section uses the ALEKS assessment and learning system. Students are required to purchase an ALEKS code to access the course online. The code is non-refundable and costs $60 for an 11-week code for Summer Session. ......PROCTORING: This course has a final exam that will be administered online via Respondus ......ALTERNATIVE REGISTRATION OPTION: A 16-week self-paced version of this class will also be available as part of the academic year term (not summer term). Registration for the self-paced class is done through https://netmath.illinois.edu/register/college (not Self-Service). The self-paced section has identical content and proctoring requirements, but students in the self-paced section are required to purchase an $81 non-refundable 18-week (1-semester) ALEKS code to access the course online.
